cohort: 580 women with a singleton pregnancy admitted to a single tertiary referral center between 2004 and 2014 for expectant management of PPROM at 20 + 0 to 28 + 6 weeks' gestation
finding: In women with early PPROM, both oligohydramnios and severe oligohydramnios at presentation were independently associated with severe neonatal respiratory morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was independently associated with severe neonatal respiratory morbidity.
